wup2025.citation: UN DESA Population Division (2025), World Urbanization Prospects: The 2025 Revision, File 19 (POP/DB/WUP/Rev.2025/F19)
wup2025.definition: Cities as defined by the Degree of Urbanisation: contiguous 1 km2 grid cells with at least 1,500 inhabitants per km2 and at least 50,000 inhabitants in total. This is an urban-extent definition, not an administrative one.

wup2018.citation: UN DESA Population Division (2018), World Urbanization Prospects: The 2018 Revision, File 12: Population of Urban Agglomerations with 300,000 Inhabitants or More in 2018, by country, 1950-2035
wup2018.definition: Urban agglomeration (or the national statistical concept the UN adopted for that city); narrower than the 2025 revision's urban extents.

ho-chi-minh-city.wup2018_name: Thành Pho Ho Chí Minh (Ho Chi Minh City)
